spec.title: GOTHAM SPEED
spec.oneLiner: Batman and the Flash battle for control of Gotham in a fast, tactical two-player showdown.
mechanics: This is a competitive two-player one-on-one fighter: Player 1 controls Batman and Player 2 controls the Flash, with each player independently trying to win two rounds before the opponent.

Both fighters move left/right, face the opponent automatically, jump with Up, crouch with Down, and hold Away to guard; standing guard blocks mid/high attacks while crouch guard blocks mid/low attacks, and guard only works from the opponent-facing side.

A performs a light punch; Down+A performs a low sweep; B performs a heavy kick; airborne A and B perform air attacks. Each attack has explicit startup, active and recovery frames, can hit a target only once, and leaves the attacker punishable during recovery.

Down+B spends 60 meter for the fighter's special. Batman throws a readable batarang projectile; the Flash performs a fast horizontal speed dash. Specials have startup and recovery, can be blocked according to their attack type, and cannot be activated without sufficient meter.

Successful attacks deal damage, produce hitstop, hitstun and directional knockback; hurt or KO states interrupt attacks. Guard reduces or negates damage but creates pushback, and repeated blocking does not last forever because the 60-second round timer closes the round.

The first fighter to deplete the opponent's health wins the round. If time expires, the fighter with more health wins; an exact health tie resolves by the higher score, then awards the round to Batman only as a deterministic final tie-break.

Rounds reset positions, health, temporary hitstun and meter while preserving the match score. The round banner allows immediate movement, jumping and practice attacks, but damage begins only after the brief countdown.

Use best-of-three rounds, with a maximum of three rounds and a match result after one fighter reaches two round wins. Award 10 points per damage dealt, 50 for a linked follow-up, and 500 for each round win; score each hit once.

Start with readable pressure and recovery: the first seconds permit movement and single attacks, then spacing and specials become available. CPU fallback uses bounded reaction delay and visible recovery when only one player is selected; in two-player mode there is no CPU behavior.
spec.artDirection: Use the supplied ARCADE.fighter Batman and Flash animation sets without replacing or recoloring their identities. Fighters are roughly 48–60 pixels tall on the 256x224 shared rooftop stage. Batman must read through the pointed cowl, black cape, chest emblem and broad grounded stance; show clear idle, walk, crouch, guard, punch, kick, batarang, hurt, jump and KO poses. Flash must read through the red mask, yellow ear bolts, lightning emblem and forward-leaning speed stance; show clear idle, run, crouch, guard, punches, kicks, speed dash, hurt, jump and KO poses. Keep the rooftop skyline, moon, water tower and parapet as quiet layered background shapes, with fighters and hit effects using the strongest palette contrast. Reserve the top HUD area for health, round status, meter and timer; keep ground shadows and a clean central combat lane readable.

preserve: Shared-screen one-on-one fighting with distinct fighters
Directional movement, jumping, crouching, blocking, attacks, specials, hitstun, knockback and punishable recovery
Timed best-of-three round structure with health, KO and timeout resolution
change: Use Batman and the Flash as the two playable fighters
Make both fighters visually recognizable through their signature silhouettes, colors and action poses
Provide proper fighting moves, blocking and character-specific specials

controls.left: Move left; if held away from the opponent, guard
controls.right: Move right; if held away from the opponent, guard
controls.down: Crouch; with A, perform a low sweep; with B, activate a special if meter is full enough
controls.a: Light punch; Down+A is sweep; in air, air punch
controls.b: Heavy kick; Down+B is special; in air, air kick

spec.lose: Lose the match by losing two rounds; lose a round when health reaches zero or when the timer resolves against you.
spec.scoring: Score 10×damage, +50 for a linked follow-up, and +500 for each round win.
